name: Critter
description: Every shot sends a biting critter after the nearest enemy.
details: Every shot sends a critter in your color running at the nearest enemy. It keeps a short distance and lunges to bite, like wave critters. Critter speed = 60% of your bullet speed, bite = your bullet damage, health = 10% of yours, at most 6 at once. Fire rate is reset to 1 shot per second when you take it.
